decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management know-how, so its in-house R&D can interpret early results and refine the product.
The cleaning centrifuge builds directly on the firm's filtration expertise, so it can absorb customer feedback and improve the product with little risk.
The coolant nozzle line with several models complements the firm's coolant systems and fits its existing metalworking customer base.
The scraper belt chip conveyor sits at the heart of the firm's established conveyor knowledge, so performance signals are easy to read and act on.
The magnetic belt conveyor uses the firm's deep chip-conveying competence and serves a stable segment of metalworking customers.
The hinged belt conveyor is a core product type for the firm, closely tied to its existing engineering and service capabilities.
